title: Crotopus
summary: Crotopus is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Argos, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2519. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2519 = 1514 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 784a
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2519. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2519 = 1514 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 784a
reign.note: Year cell "3201 2519 6". The third printed figure 6 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 21 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row.

reign.date: Crotopus King of the Argiues, with whom Moses liued, and in whose time about his tenth yeere Moses died
reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. VI, sig. 211a–211b
reign.note: Body intake. About the tenth yeere of Crotopus, Moses died. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.
